reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) confirms that rapid quenching (10^5–10^6 K/s) produces an amorphous structure, but it does not provide data on cooling rates beyond this range, on thermal stability during reheating, or on the effect of further increasing cooling rate on amorphous homogeneity or crystallization behavior. The key premises about improvement from even higher cooling rates are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
